props.name: actionsRef
props.description: A ref to imperative actions. - `unmount`: Ends the closing phase of the menu after an externally controlled closing animation finishes. Call `preventUnmountOnClose()` in `onOpenChange` first, otherwise the menu completes closing on its own. Whether it leaves the DOM is decided by `keepMounted` on the portal. - `close`: Closes the menu imperatively when called.

props.name: highlightItemOnHover
props.description: Whether moving the pointer over items should highlight them. Disabling this prop allows CSS `:hover` to be differentiated from the `:focus` (`data-highlighted`) state.

props.name: loopFocus
props.description: Whether to loop keyboard focus back to the first item when the end of the list is reached while using the arrow keys.

props.name: onItemHighlighted
props.description: Callback fired when an item is highlighted or unhighlighted. Receives the highlighted item element (or `undefined` if no item is highlighted) and details containing the reason for the change, the event, and the item's text label. The `reason` can be: - `'keyboard'`: the highlight changed due to keyboard navigation. - `'pointer'`: the highlight changed due to pointer hovering. The event may be a `MouseEvent` rather than a `PointerEvent`. - `'none'`: the highlight changed for another reason, such as automatic highlighting while filtering, the item list changing, or the popup opening or closing.

name: ContextMenuContent
description: The menu: its items scroll inside the room the positioner leaves it (`--available-height`), with their edges faded, and a `ContextMenuPinnedFooter` stays below them. `className` is the popup's (its width); the items are laid out in a column inside the scroller.

props.name: alignOffset
props.description: Offset along the alignment axis in pixels. A submenu's takes back the popup's 4px inset, so that its first item is level with its item.

props.name: collisionAvoidance
props.description: How the popup keeps inside the window: the menu shifts and never flips; a submenu flips to the other side of its item, never above or below it.

props.name: collisionPadding
props.description: Additional space to maintain from the edge of the collision boundary: 8px from the window's edge, and 8px from a frame inset where a shell keeps one. A value you pass is kept as it is.

props.name: side
props.description: Which side of its anchor the popup goes on: the menu to the right of the point, a submenu beside its item, to the end side.

props.name: sideOffset
props.description: Distance between the anchor and the popup in pixels.

props.name: sticky
props.description: Keep the popup in the window even when its anchor leaves it. A submenu is sticky, so that where it fits on neither side of its item it slides along the window's edge.

props.name: align
props.description: How to align the popup relative to the specified side.

props.name: anchor
props.type: Element | VirtualElement | RefObject<Element | null> | (() => Element | VirtualElement | null)
props.description: An element to position the popup against. By default, root context menus are positioned at the pointer, and submenus are positioned against their trigger.

props.name: arrowPadding
props.description: Minimum distance to maintain between the arrow and the edges of the popup.

props.name: collisionBoundary
props.description: An element or a rectangle that delimits the area that the popup is confined to.

props.name: disableAnchorTracking
props.description: Whether to disable the popup from tracking any layout shift of its positioning anchor.

props.name: finalFocus
props.type: boolean | RefObject<HTMLElement | null> | ((closeType: InteractionType) => boolean | HTMLElement | null | void)
props.description: Determines the element to focus when the menu is closed.

name: ContextMenuPinnedFooter
description: Items kept below the menu's scrolling items, after a separator, however long the list is: an action on the whole list. Write it among the items, as the menu's last child; it is drawn below the scroller and comes last for the arrow keys too.
